Snapshot load command that builds the tile topology and prints load progress metrics.

# Purpose
This file defines the `snapshot-load` command for Firedancer. It builds a topology for loading a snapshot into the runtime, sets up the required workspaces and tiles, and then starts the pipeline in a single process. The topology includes the `metric`, `snapct`, `snapld`, `snapdc`, and `snapin` tiles, plus the links between them for control data, compressed snapshot data, decompressed data, and parsed snapshot records. It also creates and connects the `funk` and `txncache` shared objects that the `snapin` tile uses while it restores account state.

The file also handles command-line parsing for `--tile-cpus`, configures the Firedancer stages, and runs the snapshot load while printing live progress and throughput data. During execution, it reads tile metrics to report compressed and raw bandwidth, backpressure time, busy time, and account insertion rate. The `fd_action_snapshot_load` object exposes the command as a device action with its name, argument parser, permission check, and command function.
